senses.gloss: f.(b. h. אֲבֵדה; אבד)lost or missed object. שומר א׳ the keeper of a lost object waiting for its owner to claim it B. Mets. 29ᵃ; a. fr.—בעל א׳ the owner of the lost thing.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 2b:13">Kidd. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>בעל א׳ מחזיר וכ׳</he> the owner hunts for what he has lost, i.e. man woos woman (allud. to <cite ref="Genesis 2:21">Gen. II, 21</cite>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Moed Katan 25b:12">M. Kat. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>בכו לאובדים ולא לא׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>בכו לאבילים</he>) weep for the losers, but not for the lost (deceased).

senses.gloss: loss, decrease. אֲבֵידַת נפש decrease of physical strength.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 74b">Yoma 74ᵇ</cite>.—(Y. ib. VIII, 44ᵈ top <he>אב בית</he> read <he>אבידת</he>).
